list: The official 55 trophies as published by PlayStation (Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; every guide below is written in my own words from those official descriptions.
sourceNote: Trophy names, descriptions and grades come from the official list as mirrored by Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies) and PSNProfiles (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi). The game launched on 19 November 2026, so exact locations and steps are not yet verified in play; guides say so where they reason from the description rather than confirmed play.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: No separate task: this trophy pops by itself the instant the other 54 are all done. Work the five roadmap stages in order and check the Next Up tab for whatever is still missing.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing all the way through. It is the first mission, so it arrives early; still, play it clean on your first run, because whether missions can be replayed has not been confirmed yet.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Clear the story missions of Chapter 1 in order. The trophy lands when the chapter's closing mission ends — nothing extra to find, just keep moving through the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, this one is simply about reaching the end of the chapter, so push through the missions and it will pop.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 3 to its last mission. No side content is needed for this one — finishing the chapter is the whole requirement.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. It is the final chapter trophy before the finale, and it unlocks when the chapter's last mission wraps up.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Beat the campaign's final mission to take the story gold. Before you start the finale, sweep up anything one-time you still want — partner moments, story choices and mission-specific trophies — in case the story does not let you go back freely afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. The trophy pops at the end of the mission, so give it a proper first attempt — mission replay is still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heists tend to run in stages, so follow the markers through each one and finish the job; do it right the first time in case missions cannot be replayed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. The trophy unlocks when the mission ends — as with the other named-mission trophies, treat the first attempt as the one that counts.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission on your first run; replay has not been confirmed, so don't rush past its objectives.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The trophy pops when the takedown is done — finish it properly on your first attempt.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The trophy unlocks at the end of the mission, so play it through cleanly the first time.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Push the in-game completion counter to 100% — story, side missions, activities and collectibles, which is effectively everything else on this list. Leave it for last: it is the second gold, and the in-game stats page shows which categories are still short.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Rack up 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida — jumps, near misses, long air and drifts all count. Let it build naturally while you drive, then mop up the rest late in the game by chaining jumps off ramps and hills in free roam.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type at least once — races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation and stunts are the ones this list covers. Work through the activity trophies one by one and this pops when the last type is tried; the in-game activities menu shows what is on offer if one type is unclear.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — PlayStation tracks 42 of them (PSNProfiles count). Visit the range, beat each challenge's gold target score or time, and retry the ones you miss as often as you like; challenges can be retried freely.
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN count: 42 Shooting Range challenges)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations around Leonida. Find the race spots, enter each one and finish first — a practice run to learn the course, then a run to win. The trophy needs a win everywhere, not just one.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct race events — the same race 20 times does not count. Move through the race locations across Leonida in different vehicles and race types; each event's win counts once.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing challenge and out-fish him. Find the fishing spots around Leonida, enter a challenge against Cal and land the better catch; if you lose, challenge him again until you win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade game to completion at an arcade in Leonida. Find a machine, start a game and finish it — any title counts, and it is a quick one to tick off whenever you pass an arcade.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through all of Andy's missions until the final one is complete. Side strands usually unlock as the story moves on, so check back with Andy between chapters, and finish the last mission properly the first time — side-mission replay is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand, from its first job to its last. Check back with Kenton as the story advances, and give the final mission a clean first attempt in case side missions cannot be replayed.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's missions until the final one is done. Revisit Billy between story chapters as new jobs unlock, and finish the last one properly on your first run.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the Strangers & Freaks style side missions. Watch for stranger markers on the map as you explore, play each strand to its end, and keep count: the silver pops at the eighth completed strand. New strands open up as the story advances, so revisit new areas as they unlock.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's missions to the final one. Check back with Randy as the story moves forward, and finish the last mission on your first attempt, since side-mission replay is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand. Revisit Tyrone between story chapters as jobs unlock, and complete the final mission cleanly the first time.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find every meditation spot in Leonida and meditate at each one. The spots are scattered across the state, including quiet and scenic places — explore the map thoroughly and keep track of where you have already been; the trophy pops at the last spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks about. Follow Bret's strand, track the animal to its habitat and make the kill. If the hunt fails, try again — the animal should be findable again.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect enough cards to finish 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden all over Leonida, so search area by area and keep count per set; work on it alongside exploration and mop up the last sets after the story.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. The spots are spread all over the map — visit each one and use it, working region by region so none are missed. The trophy pops at the 100th distinct location.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind — driving, combat, exploration and more. Open the challenges menu and tick them off as you play; 50 comes naturally if you chase the other trophies, since many of them complete challenges along the way.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. This only works while your partner is with you, so grab the chance when it comes — build the heat to 4 stars, break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears. Flagged missable because the partner moment may not come back.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the trick is keeping the heat on the whole time. Plan a route past three shops, hit them one after another, and don't let the cops lose you in between. This needs your partner present, so do it when the chance comes.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida — drive, ride or find them and they count. Explore the map, try every vehicle type you come across, and watch the vehicle count in the stats; mop up the rare ones late in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: During a single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Find a spot with enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus and chain the takedowns before it runs out — a gang hideout or a heavy police response works well. Aim for quick, clean kills.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — get a plane off the ground at VCIA outside any scheduled flight. Steal a plane, start it up and take off before airport security and the police stop you. This reads like a one-time story moment, so do it when the moment comes rather than counting on free roam.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank — the description says it all. Rhinos usually show up at high wanted levels or around military areas; once you climb into one, the trophy should pop.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth job. Plan the approach, avoid cameras and guards, and get in and out clean. If you are spotted the attempt fails, so take it slow and quiet; a clean first run is the goal, though you can retry.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Find the banks, crack their vaults and get away clean — five times over. Plan each robbery, escape the heat after each one, and keep count until the fifth.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away before the police close in. Trucks roam the map, so this can be done in free roam whenever you spot one.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore the whole of Leonida — every region of the map. Drive, fly and walk into every corner until the map is fully revealed. This pairs naturally with the collectible and vehicle trophies: explore thoroughly and it pops on its own.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida — one per gang. Find each gang's operations, hit them and get away. Cover every gang, and keep a list of which ones you have done and which are left.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. Find the bar or spot on Ocean Beach with the view, sit down with a drink and the trophy pops. Do it whenever you are passing through Vice City.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — drive a car straight through the showroom glass, classic GTA style. Find a showroom, get in a car inside it and floor it through the front. This looks like a story moment, so if it pops during a mission, do it when the moment comes rather than counting on free roam.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — follow through on a game there. Find the alley, start a game of bowling and play it through. A quick activity trophy to tick off whenever you are nearby.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — the description is vague, so this is likely tied to growing your partnership's following or reputation in the game. Work on partnership activities and social-facing goals as they appear, and check the in-game stats for a partnership or follower count to push up. The exact trigger is not yet known from the official description alone.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a story choice — the trophy pops when a decision with consequences is made. Story choices are one-time by nature: once you pick, you cannot unpick it. Think before you choose, and be aware different choices may gate different outcomes; if you want a specific result, save before the choice if the game allows it. Flagged missable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Do something a second time and get it right — the description suggests retrying something that failed the first time. The exact trigger is not yet known from the official description alone; it may be tied to replaying a mission or redoing a failed attempt. Keep playing and watch for it after a retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Something strange happens — this reads like a secret or easter-egg trophy for stumbling into an odd event in Leonida. The exact trigger is not yet known from the official description alone. Explore, poke at strange places and events, and it should pop when you find it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock enemies over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Get a vehicle moving past a group of enemies, lean out and swing. A fast car and a crowded street make this much easier; aim for a clean hit at speed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to clean them, and keep doing it until $250,000 has been laundered. This money grind builds up naturally if you keep robbing and laundering, and pairs with the bank vault and armored truck trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops of Leonida — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food, anything sold in a shop counts toward the total. Keep shopping as you play and the total climbs; late in the game, buy big-ticket items to finish it off. Check the stats to see how much you have spent so far.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages cost money, so save up — this pairs with the spending and laundering trophies. Visit each property, buy it, and keep going until every garage is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, register each one through the app, and repeat until ten are registered. Any vehicles count, so grab the easy ones first and keep an eye on the count.
